question: The origin of most of the classical dance forms of India is _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Natya Shastra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Natya Shastra:-**

 
 
• **Natya Shastra is a treatise on the art of theatre, dance, and music. It is considered to be one of the oldest and most comprehensive texts on these subjects. **
 
• **The text is attributed to Bharata Muni, a sage who is said to have lived in the 2ⁿd century BCE.**
 
• Natya Shastra is divided into 36 chapters and covers a wide range of topics, including the history of theatre, the different types of plays, the roles of the actors, the costumes, the music, and the dance.
 
• The text also provides detailed instructions on how to perform a play.
 
• Natya Shastra has had a profound influence on the development of theatre, dance, and music in India.
 
• It is still studied and performed today, and it is considered to be a classic work of Indian literature.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yajur Veda:-**

 
 
• **It is one of the four Vedas, the sacred scriptures of Hinduism. **
 
• It is a collection of mantras, or sacred utterances, that are used in religious rituals. Yajur Veda is divided into two main parts: the Black Yajur Veda and the White Yajur Veda.
 
 
 
• **Artha Shastra:-**
 
 
• **It is a treatise on economics, politics, and statecraft. **
 
• It is considered to be one of the oldest and most important works on these subjects.
 
• The text is attributed to Kautilya, a minister to the Mauryan emperor Chandragupta Maurya.
 
 
 
• **Atharva Veda:-**
 
 
• **It is one of the four Vedas, the sacred scriptures of Hinduism. **
 
• It is a collection of mantras, or sacred utterances, that are used in a variety of rituals.
 
• Atharva Veda is divided into 20 books and contains over 7000 mantras.
